author: Shopclass
description_html:
Bender

Dependencies

  • Node.js
  • Sass

Once you have the dependencies installed, run the following command:

$> npm install

Structure

There are two template files:

  • index.php.tpl
  • sass/colors.scss.tpl

If you want to generate them again, you just have to execute grunt template:blue.

Watch changes

You can compile sass files automatically every time it's changed by executing the following command:

$> grunt watch:blue

Build

$> grunt dist

It generates a .zip file per color scheme: blue (default), red, black and purple. The index.php and colors.scss are generated from the variables in themes.json. The screenshots are taken from screenshot/{color scheme}/screenshot.png.
name: bender
short_description: The legacy default Shopclass theme, replaced by Storefront in 6.0.0. Maintained for existing installs.

versions.changelog_html:
Final Bender release — jQuery-free, PHP 8.0, updated for Shopclass 6.0.x (core user avatar, social share, native-dialog photo lightbox, vanilla uploader, equal-height grid).

Only the default (blue) variant is published. The old red / black / purple colour variants were generated by a Ruby Compass + Grunt build that is now retired and no longer runs, so multi-colour packages are no longer produced. This is the last planned Bender release — Storefront is the maintained theme.
